summary: Phase 2c preview-mode honesty check: Pool tab renders new PREVIEW MODE :: SEPOLIA banner (data-testid='pool-preview-banner') at top of render tree with text 'STRK20 privacy is live on Starknet mainnet only...'. Wallet panel and 'What Stays Visible' panel render below. All 6 nav tabs (harvest, tokens, ledger, universe, device, pool) navigate correctly. Backend /api/status, /api/pubkey, /api/ledger all return 200. No console errors. docs/mainnet-transaction-plan.md contains 'Mainnet Cutover Checklist' (line 1). Preview banner logic uses /sepolia/i.test(rpcUrl) so it will correctly NOT appear on mainnet RPC URLs. Action buttons (shield/transfer/unshield) are only shown after wallet connect — soft-fail logic in runAction() short-circuits with kind='preview_mode' when previewMode=true, which is intended UX.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview banner shows correctly on Sepolia. To verify mainnet-hides-banner behavior, one would need to change REACT_APP_STARKNET_RPC to a mainnet URL and restart frontend — not tested since env kept on Sepolia intentionally for hackathon demo.
